notes.title: Rosemary's Fate Major Update 2025 & promo
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

We’ve added an animated compass in the bottom right corner to help you navigate the audio-visual locations more easily. This new feature makes the gameplay smoother and more intuitive.



To celebrate, we’re offering a limited-time 75% discount!



Thank you all for your support and valuable feedback. Rosemary’s Fate keeps evolving — join us and see what’s next!

notes.title: Rosemary's Fate Major Update 2024
notes.notes:
Full notes:

• 15 New Achievements. Collect them of your journey through the dark. 

• Location Selection. Now you can choose location to continue your adventure. 

• Locations re-design. We've listened to your feedback and enhancing both 
navigation and audio cues to enrich experience in some locations. 

• Some other bugs fixed and polished code. 

Thank you for your continuous support and feedback. 
We're still developing Rosemary`s Fate!

notes.notes:
